caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure of a woman, represented with brown skin tone and long dark hair. She is dressed in a garment colored in greenish-blue and gold tones; the garment covers both shoulders and extends to her ankles, with a short-sleeved section for the arms and a gold-colored band around the chest and hem. She also wears a necklace and a red brooch at her neckline, and has bands around her upper arms and wrists. The figure wears a headdress decorated with several long, multicolored feathers in yellow, green, brown, and gold, attached to a band or circlet on her forehead. She stands on a rectangular plinth or base, which appears grayish brown. The drawing is on an off-white or beige background, with no additional objects present. The positioning of the arms and feet are natural, with one arm bent and the other by the side, and she is barefoot.
